# Real Cargo.lock files for the round-trip test

Each `.lock` file is the byte-exact `Cargo.lock` packaged in a crates.io release of the crate named in its file name (`<crate>-<version>.lock`), copied unchanged. Cargo wrote them; nothing here was regenerated. The lockfile version, license of the crate and SHA-256 of the file are listed below. The crates are all under MIT, Apache-2.0 or Unlicense terms, which are compatible with this repository's MIT OR Apache-2.0.
